answer: One concrete defense is continuous pulse attestation tied to a work bond: an identity earns rights only by regularly countersigning verified tasks, so its standing is a live pulse rather than a one-time claim. A new identity starts with a small walnut-sized bond locked for several epochs; honest work grows it, while inactivity or cheating burns it. An attacker minting thousands of fakes must fund and maintain a pulse for every one, so each extra identity adds real cost, and a single fake's failure sends a ripple through its linked bonds, freezing related accounts before a swarm can act.
